stepTitle: What is the component score of the first principal component?
stepBody:
Angela collected a dataset of $$3$$ data points. Upon applying PCA to this dataset, Angela obtains matrices $$ \cup , $$ $$S, $$ and $$V.$$
For your convenience, matrices $$ \cup $$ and $$V$$ have been rounded. The rows of $$ \cup $$ are:
• $$(0.8, 0.6, 0)$$
• $$(-0.4, 0.6, -0.7)$$
• $$(-0.4, 0.6, 0.7)$$
The rows of $$S$$ are:
• $$(4, 0, 0)$$
• $$(0, 1, 0)$$
• $$(0, 0, 0)$$
The rows of $$V$$ are:
• $$(0.8, -0.3, -0.3)$$
• $$(0.4, 0.6, 0.6)$$
• $$(0, 0.7, -0.7)$$
Answer the following question about using principal components based on the rounded results of PCA above.##figure2.gif##
